description: Lists the Google Analytics 4 properties the connected Google account can see (Analytics Admin API accountSummaries.list): id (numeric, the value set_ga4_property takes), displayName and the GA4 account name, sorted by account. Needs an active Google connection in the Organiq account that granted analytics.readonly; otherwise no_data with reason scope_missing / no_connection / token_revoked and the step that fixes it. Use it before set_ga4_property to find the property id, or when the user does not know their GA4 property id. Guide: https://organiqgeo.com/connect/ga4. / Lista as propriedades GA4 da conta Google conectada, para escolher o id em set_ga4_property.
name: list_ga4_properties
title: GA4 properties of the Google account
